correctness.rationale: Assume an asymptotically quasi-homogeneous planar balance equation Y′=-(1/k)Λ_αY+f_{α,k}(Y), k>0, has a nonconstant T-periodic solution with p_α(Y)>0 and the cited source’s Assumption 4.2. Positivity makes the weighted scaling vector Λ_αY nonzero on the orbit. If phase Y′ and scaling Λ_αY were dependent at every time, continuity gives Y′=a(t)Λ_αY, hence Y=s(t)^{Λ_α}Y(0) with s>0. At the initial ray point the balance equation forces the principal vector field tangent to the scaling ray; weighted homogeneity f_{α,k}(s^{Λ_α}Y)=s^k s^{Λ_α}f_{α,k}(Y) then reduces log s to autonomous scalar u′=-1/k+b exp(ku). A nonconstant scalar autonomous orbit cannot be periodic, and periodicity of Y with a positive-weight nonzero coordinate forces periodicity of u. Contradiction establishes some full rank; the source’s propagation property makes rank full throughout. In dimension exactly two the distinguished phase/scaling invariant subbundle fills the variational space, giving precisely multipliers 1 and e^{T_η}>1. The focal conditional blow-up criterion then applies. This does not construct any periodic profile or prove analogues in dimension greater than two.
